evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: the right-edge shade band greys the rust node and its graphite dots flow back toward the central web; by shot-20s eight radial nodes feed one centred sink web, so the reversal and the sink both read.
evidence.ambition: shot-02s: four colour-coded canopy nodes, a thin hyphal web and sparse dot streams; shot-20s: radial mirror of eight nodes, a rust Gray-Scott spot ring and a dense central web, all in one 2D plane.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: flat cream ground with soft rust blobs whose edges step into visible pixel blocks at full size; the dot streams look sparse against the claimed peak, and the rust bands are the weakest finish.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: cream, rust and amber fungal palette with root nodes and no birds or card weave; shot-20s: a centred rust spot ring with radial hyphae, unlike the flock, weave or sphere anchors.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: nodes sit composed in the lower third; shot-20s resolves into a centred mirrored web that differs from the opening, though the nodes are small and the outer cream field stays empty.

Raise the live dot count toward the claimed peak so the streams at shot-02s read as flows, not sparse dashes on the hyphae.
Fade the root tips and tint the reversed dots more strongly at the 8 s shade cut so the reversal reads at a glance, not as a grey node.
